articles.title: Russian glide bomb attack on Zaporizhzhia kills at least 20 people
articles.description: Volodymyr Zelensky says the attack, which left children dead, was Russia expressing its "thanks" for a US diesel deal.

articles.title: Several injured in attack on airport in Saudi capital Riyadh
articles.description: The US embassy says it is "aware of attacks on King Khalid International Airport", which come days after Yemen's Houthis said they had struck it.

articles.title: Woman injures three people in third Poland school knife attack in a week
articles.description: Polish police had already deployed to schools after a female caretaker was killed and several others injured in two earlier attacks in two days.

articles.title: Nobel peace laureate says US sanctions on ICC 'unacceptable'
articles.description: Navi Pillay says the Trump administrations' sweeping penalties on the international tribunal were "unheard of".

articles.title: Drone strike by Sudan paramilitary kills 41 near Ethiopian border, rights group says
articles.description: Eight children are said to be among those killed by the strike, which hit a gathering of displaced people.

articles.title: Flydubai attacker began a 'drift towards extremism and terrorism' in Australia, UAE says
articles.description: The United Arab Emirates' attorney-general also alleges the co-pilot was trying to crash the plane into Tel Aviv's airport.

articles.title: Russian search engine Yandex struggles after Ukrainian strikes on data centres
articles.description: Often dubbed "Russia's Google", the tech firm admits customers may experience disruption to digital services due to the attacks.

articles.title: At least 12 killed and hundreds injured in Saudi Arabia airport 'missile attack'
articles.description: At least 12 have been killed and hundreds injured in strikes on the King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, officials have said.

articles.title: Flydubai hijacker planned to crash aircraft in 9/11-inspired attack, UAE says
articles.description: The alleged hijacker of a flydubai plane planned to crash into Israel's Ben Gurion airport, according to a senior Emirati official.
